Repair the DXP head selector. Implement function solve(input). Input has commits: array of {id,experienceId,validity} and refs: object mapping branch names to commit IDs. Only current unique ref targets matter. Return sorted unique IDs of active current heads, except exclude ALL current heads of an experience if ANY current head of that same experience is quarantined. Historical non-head quarantines do not block restored active heads. Ignore refs pointing to missing commits. Do not mutate input. function solve(input) { const ids = Object.values(input.refs); return input.commits.filter(c => ids.includes(c.id) && c.validity === 'active').map(c => c.id).sort(); }

visibleAnswer: function solve(input) { const ids = Object.values(input.refs); const activeHeads = input.commits.filter(c => ids.includes(c.id) && c.validity === 'active').map(c => c.id); const quarantinedHeads = input.commits.filter(c => ids.includes(c.id) && c.validity === 'quarantined').map(c => c.id); const activeCurrentHeads = activeHeads.filter(h => !quarantinedHeads.includes(h)); return activeCurrentHeads.sort(); }
